notes: Polished nickel/champagne serif caps, widely spaced, initial V and S about 1.2x the rest (the VS wordmark; built as four parts because the font's small caps are composite glyphs the builder can't read), reverse-lit: warm white halo on the wall below/behind. On the blush-pink glossy panel fascia above a brushed-nickel picture-frame portal. Font Cinzel Bold (OFL), the nearest free Trajan-like face; the real VS face has slightly wider S/C and finer serifs. Size from the portal opening taken as 3.0 m tall: big caps ~0.275 m, word ~4.3 m (+-10%). A second, smaller unlit 'VICTORIA'S / SECRET' on the return wall (IMG_4475) is not built.
